summary: Install-time exfiltration of host and environment metadata to hardcoded remote endpoint
details: bb-twl-k7x2@1.0.0 runs canary.js from both `install` and `postinstall` lifecycle scripts, which fires automatically on `npm install` without consent. The script collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), process.env.USER, process.cwd(), platform/arch) and enumerates the names of all environment variables (Object.keys(process.env)), then sends the collected data via an HTTP GET query string to the hardcoded endpoint http://whstool.brkd.no/cb53e6db-e043-4383-89e9-853c9088ee5d over plain HTTP. The unique GUID path correlates each install back to the author's collector. The package's self-description as a 'bug bounty canary' does not change the behavior: any installer of this package has its host and environment metadata exfiltrated to a third-party endpoint it never opted into.
